slides.title: Same hosting and database versions
slides.body: As the live app, on smaller, cheaper machines. It can be switched off outside working hours if cost matters.

slides.title: Deploys from the same pipeline
slides.body: Then every release to staging is also a rehearsal of the release to production.

slides.title: Realistic data, personal details removed
slides.body: Real customer records don't belong in a test environment, least of all in healthcare.

slides.title: Integrations on test accounts
slides.body: Payment and messaging providers in test mode, so testing never charges a card or emails a customer.

slides.title: A rollback you've tried
slides.body: Ask how long one takes, and when you last ran it.

slides.title: A named person signs off
slides.body: Someone who uses the software completes the whole task on staging, including an exception from real work.
